I just heard about this AMAZING pool party! Thassa’s Oracle made the coolest playlist, Llawan is bringing her royal coterie and her pet cuttlefish, plus the Master of Waves is even turning the whole pool into a lazy river. Thassa said everyone’s invited so grab your swimsuit and bring some chips. Plus, all the art was done by Lauren YS. And she’s so cool.
It’s gonna be AWESOME.

Contents:
